front-pane-boundary-projection.json.scope: Exact FRONT pane full perimeter samples from actual final mesh. Roof/rear and side panes excluded.

final-backing-only-scope-proof.json.scope: Exact semantic comparison of first-pass and final actual exports, excluding random material UUIDs and sequential mesh IDs.
final-backing-only-scope-proof.json.note: Wing-only proof transfers exactly to final wing. Whole-car four-pose images retain the first-pass diffuser and are not relabeled as final whole-scene renders.

functionalWingPoseProof.scope: Exact target expressions evaluated from physics-main.js; only actual cloned activeWingGroup transforms change. No wing angle baked into source vertices and no physics edited.
